summary: The note surveys the resources offered by Mercy General Hospital, based on engagement with its staff and management since September 2023. It covers support staff, chaplaincy and nutrition services, upgraded radiology, specialty clinics, community outreach, mental health, rehabilitation, preventative programs, financial counseling and education partnerships. It argues that residents often underuse these services simply because they are unaware of them.
one_line: An overview of Mercy General Hospital's staff, technology, clinics, outreach, and support services that residents may be underusing.
key_facts: Mercy General Hospital's team includes dietitians, social workers, administrative officers, cleaners and others, not just doctors and nurses.
Social worker Sarah Thompson connects patients with hospital resources and community services and helps them navigate post-hospital care.
Chaplain Michael Daniels has overseen chaplaincy services since October 2023, offering spiritual support regardless of faith.
Dietician Julie Park manages nutrition services, which accommodate all dietary restrictions and include diet education after discharge.
The radiology department, updated in November 2023, has advanced MRI and CT scanners; Dr. Raymond Kirk is head of Radiology.
The Cancer Care Center opened in December 2023 and is directed by Dr. Laura Gibson, coordinating oncology services from chemotherapy to counseling.
The Pediatric Wing was renovated in January 2024 with a play area and vibrant murals; Lead Pediatrician Dr. Alex Moreno stresses family-centered care.
The Mobile Health Unit, launched in February 2024 and headed by Nurse Practitioner Hannah Lee, provides screenings and basic medical services to underserved populations.
Community Health Manager Lisa Martinez coordinates free workshops and health fairs offering screenings, immunizations and lifestyle advice.
Counselor Tom Sanders leads therapist-led support groups within the psychiatric department, which serves inpatients and outpatients.
The Rehabilitation Center has been guided by Physiotherapist Jennifer Clarke since its revamp in March 2024.
Dr. Omar Khan, a preventative health specialist who joined in April 2024, supports programs such as heart health education, diabetes management courses and smoking cessation.
Financial counselor Emily Nguyen helps with payment options, insurance and financial assistance programs.
Mentorship coordinator Dr. Benjamin Lee oversees partnerships with local schools and internship programs for students interested in health careers.
